comparison.success_criterion: On buggy revision 9cd2f3d91765, the assertions in test_mul_bounds_zero_times_inf fail because mul_bounds returns NaN in place of finite bounds for cases like [0, inf]*[0, inf] and/or [-inf,0]*[0,inf]. On the fixed revision from PR#3267, the same test passes because NaN products produced by endpoint multiplication (IEEE-754 0*inf) are suppressed/replaced with 0.0 so returned bounds are finite where expected.
